title: Bevel heading
description: A centered (or left) semibold heading with tight -0.03em tracking and line-height 1, fluid from 41px to 64px (or 50px to 80px for a page title), over a 20–24px medium lead in 60% ink.
notes: pass a span with text-muted-foreground inside the title for the two-tone headings
name: bevel-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the heading; may hold a muted span for a two-tone title

props.name: size
props.description: xl = page title (h1), lg = section title, md = card title
